# mtncloud_cyphers (Data Source)

Lists your Cypher keys, including those made in the console. Keys in Cypher, MTN Cloud's secret store, with their leases. Values are never listed: read one with `mtncloud_cypher`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only those whose name matches; leave name_regex out to list them all.
data "mtncloud_cyphers" "all" {
  name_regex = "^secret/"
}

output "cyphers" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_cyphers.all.cyphers : x.key => x.expire_date }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_regex` (String) Only return Cypher keys whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.

### Read-Only

- `cyphers` (Attributes List) The Cypher keys, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cyphers))

<a id="nestedatt--cyphers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cyphers`

Read-Only:

- `created_by` (String) Who created the key.
- `expire_date` (String) When the lease ends (RFC 3339), or empty.
- `id` (Number) ID of the Cypher key.
- `key` (String) Name of the Cypher key.
- `last_accessed` (String) Last read (RFC 3339), or empty.
- `lease_timeout` (Number) Lease in seconds; the key is removed when it ends.
